in_hebrew.name: רוזאבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רוזאבל הוא שילוב של שני מילים: רוזה, שפירושה ורד, ושבל, שפירושה שחר או בוקר. הוא מתאר את השקיעה היפהפייה של השחר, ומשויך לתקווה, לחיים חדשים, ולרעננות של הבוקר.

in_greek.name: Ροζαμπέλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ροζαμπέλ είναι σύνθεση δύο λέξεων: Ρόσα, που σημαίνει τριαντάφυλλο, και Μπέλ, που σημαίνει χαρά ή ωραία. Αναφέρεται στο όμορφο τριαντάφυλλο που ανθίζει το πρωί, συμβολίζοντας την ελπίδα, τη νέα ζωή και την ομορφιά.

in_latin.name: Rosabel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rosabel ex duobus vocabulis componitur: Rosa, quod significat rosa, et Bel, quod significat pulchra vel matutina. Designat itaque rosam pulchram quae mane floruit, significans spem, vitam novam, et matutinam mundi renovationem.

in_english.name: Rosabel
in_english.meaning: Beautiful morning rose, symbolizing hope and new life
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rosabel is derived from the combination of two words: Rosa, meaning 'rose,' and Bel, meaning 'beautiful' or 'morning.' It signifies a beautiful morning rose, symbolizing hope, new life, and the freshness of the morning. Historically, the name Rosabel has been used in Christian traditions to represent the beauty and purity of the Virgin Mary, often referred to as the 'Rose of Sharon.' The name also reflects the Christian values of hope, renewal, and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rosabel has been cherished through various cultures and time periods. In the Middle Ages, roses symbolized the love of the Virgin Mary and were often used as decorations in churches. This link to the Virgin Mary might have influenced the use of the name Rosabel as a tribute to the sacredness and beauty of Mary and her love for God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rosabel is a powerful reminder of our connection to God. The rose symbolizes love, beauty, and pride, but also redemption, as in the case of "red" roses. The Hebrew 'El' root reminds us of God's creative power and divine nature. Together, Rosabel evokes images of the love and connection between the divine and human realms, motivating us to offer our love and devotion to God.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Rosabel in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Rosabel, which means "Rose of God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Rosabel: A name meaning 'gentle strength of the rose.' In Christian symbolism, the rose represents the Passion and the suffering of Christ. Thus, Rosabel signifies a strong and compassionate soul, deeply rooted in the love of God.
